newsitem.title: UK: United News up on H1 data, merger progress.
newsitem.headline: United News up on H1 data, merger progress.

text.p: LONDON, Sept 12 (Reuter - Shares in United News & Media Plc gained over one percent on Thursday, after the UK television and newspaper group said it had made significant progress after its merger with MAI and said first-half profit rose 20 percent.
United News shares rose as high as 715p in early trade but slipped slightly to trade 5-1/2p higher at 711p by 0729 GMT. The broader market was only marginally firmer at the time.

"At first sight the figures look healthy but it's hard to assess because the new merged group figures don't quite tally with what analysts had. We're waiting for the outcome of this morning's analysts' meeting," one market maker said.
Dealers said volume, at 271,575 shares traded, was moderate and likely to remain low until analysts had talked to the company.
